schema.description: A corporation's authorization granted to a specific operator account for one or more module message types (IDX-DE-QRY-3). Fee-payment capability is not part of OperatorAuthorization; it lives on the separate FeeGrant entity, queried via List Fee Grants (IDX-DE-QRY-5).

period.description: Reset period for spend_limit, as a duration (e.g. "86400s").

schema.title: OperatorAuthorization
